text:
maya: Heads-up — before we lift embargo on the benchmark blog we need one tiny clarification in the methods section. HN flagged that a chart mixes 95th and p99 without notes. Can we add a line and hardware footnote today? Embargo still noon PST tomorrow.
ryan: I can do it. Will add a concise note and regenerate the chart SVG. 95th = batching=8, p99 = batching=1, runs on A100-40GB. ETA ~90m.
olga: Please hold press outreach until the updated post is live. I'll tell top contacts it's a minor clarification only.
samir: Also add a one-line FAQ entry in the repo explaining why percentiles differ (sampling windows). Prevents repeat confusion.
maya: Good call. @ryan push changes to benchmarks repo and ping me; samir will open the FAQ PR once ryan pushes. olga, stand by for the go.
publish-bot: Reminder: scheduled publish job (marketing/publish) at 2025-07-22T19:00:00Z will remain paused until manual resume.
ryan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/415 — footnote + svg updated.
maya: Reviewing now, will greenlight once quick pass is done (about 15m). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
olga: Saved outreach note to /marketing/embargoes and queued press hold message.
samir: FAQ PR queued after ryan's merge.
maya: After live, we'll post a short pinned message in #general linking to the update and FAQ.
